sentences.text: Seeking an cipatory bail for oences under Sec ons 13 (1) (a) and 13 (2) of PC Act added as per State counsel's submission in the FIR cap oned above, the pe oner has come up before this Court under Sec on 438 CrPC.

4. Counsel for the pe oner submits that earlier the pe oner had approached this Court by  ling CRM-M No.48668 of 2022 wherein he sought the grant of an cipatory bail in the above cap oned FIR, but for oences only under Sec ons 420, 406, 409, 465, 467, 471, 120-B IPC.
A co-ordinate Bench of this Court granted bail vide order dated 31.10.2022.
1 of 2 Neutral Citation No:=2024:PHHC:006302 2024:PHHC:006302 CRM-M-462-2024 5.

Counsel for the pe oner, now has approached for grant of an cipatory bail to the pe oner for the newly added oences in the FIR cap oned above and submits that at the me of  ling the  rst an cipatory bail, the oences under Sec ons 468 IPC and 13 (1) of PC Act, 1988 or 13(1) (a), 13 (2) of PC Act were not in existence and the same were added subsequently.
Therefore, he prays for grant of concession of an cipatory bail to the pe oner in the newly added oences also.

6. State counsel has  led status report by way of adavit of Parminder Singh, Deputy Superintendent of Police, Vigilance Bureau, Unit, Sangrur and has not contested the factum that the newly added oences, whereunder the pe oner is seeking an cipatory bail, were added subsequently during the course of inves ga on and were not in existence at the me of  ling the  rst pe on.

7. Given above, since the pe oner has already been granted concession of an cipatory bail for oences under Sec ons 420, 406, 409, 465, 467, 471, 120-B IPC vide order dated 31.10.2022, therefore, this Court deems it appropriate to extend the concession of an cipatory bail to the pe oner for the newly added oences i.e. 468 IPC and 13 (1), 13 (1) (a), 13 (2) of PC Act, 1988.
8. Pe on stands allowed.
It is clari ed that this order shall not be applicable to other co-accused and their cases shall be decided individually for the reason that the pe oner was ini ally granted bail.
All pending applica ons, if any also stands disposed of.
